Pinned NSTextInputContext.initWithClient accepts an NSTextInputClient protocol object, with no NSView superclass requirement. All required methods remain implemented; window selector remains available. NSObject is an appropriate main-thread protocol client whose designated init matches this allocation.

The client never participates in the NSView hierarchy. Removing NSView removes its destructor focus-chain callbacks after objc2 drops Rust ivars. Context retains client; client retains no context and weakly references its owning window. Retirement still marks composition inactive before AppKit calls, with unchanged immutable serial checks.

Actual invisible AppKit regression exercises idempotence, replacement, retirement, 256 stale-session refusals and destruction with the last context active. Baseline abort(-6) and corrected exit0/768 contexts are retained and rehashed.
